strategy.summary: CART-12 prices the cart in src/cart.js `cartTotal(items, { coupon })`: 10% bulk discount at 10+ items (summed quantities), SAVE5 coupon taking $5 after the bulk discount with goods floored at $0, unknown coupons refused, and shipping free from $50 of discounted goods, else $4.99, with an empty cart costing nothing. Unit tests in Vitest prove each rule and its boundaries through `cartTotal`. Reading the code shows `bulkDiscount` uses `> BULK_THRESHOLD`, so a cart of exactly 10 items gets no discount: that case is expected to fail and will be recorded as a defect.
inScope: cartTotal, bulkDiscount pricing rules in src/cart.js
Boundaries: 9/10/11 items, $50 shipping threshold, $0 floor, empty cart
outOfScope: UI or API checkout (none exists in the repo)
Rounding of fractional cents beyond the cases above
assumptions: Coupon codes are case-sensitive as the code implements (only exactly 'SAVE5' is accepted).
A non-empty cart whose goods are floored to $0 by the coupon still pays $4.99 shipping, since only an empty cart is stated to cost nothing.
Refusal is the thrown Error from cartTotal; tests check the message contains the submitted code.
openQuestions: Should lowercase 'save5' be accepted? The code refuses it; the ticket doesn't say.
Should a non-empty cart whose goods are reduced to $0 by SAVE5 be charged $4.99 shipping (current behaviour)?

risks.description: Off-by-one at the bulk threshold (code uses > 10 instead of >= 10)
risks.mitigation: TC1 checks exactly 10 items across two lines; kept as expected failure with a recorded defect

risks.description: Coupon applied before bulk discount, or shipping judged on the undiscounted subtotal
risks.mitigation: TC4 and TC10 use amounts where the order changes the total

risks.description: Goods going negative with SAVE5 on a small cart

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart with 10 or more items in total (sum of line quantities) gets 10% off its subtotal; fewer than 10 gets none.
Coupon SAVE5 takes $5 off after the bulk discount, goods never below $0; any other coupon code is refused with an error.
Shipping is free when goods after discounts are $50 or more, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart costs $0.

defects.title: Bulk discount not applied to a cart of exactly 10 items
defects.description: AC1: carts with 10 or more items get 10% off. src/cart.js bulkDiscount uses `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD` (BULK_THRESHOLD = 10, documented as "at least this many"), so exactly 10 items get no discount. Expected cartTotal of 10 × $10 = 90; actual 100.
defects.evidence: TC1 is marked it.fails and passes, which means its assertion toBe(90) fails. src/cart.js:22 `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD`.
